suggestions.topic: EIP-8037 cross-frame state gas bug resolution and devnet impact
suggestions.rationale: ACDC decision expected yesterday (Sept 4) on consensus-breaking EIP-8037 PR #12265. If fix is adopted, could require ~1-month Sepolia delay and new devnet cycle. Critical path decision for fork timeline.

suggestions.topic: Devnet-9 non-finality testing status and readiness for Sepolia
suggestions.rationale: Devnet-9 launched Sept 1 as chaos network. Need status update on stability, client participation (Nimbus EL, Reth, Grandine trunk branches), and whether it unblocked Sepolia shadow fork targeting mid-to-end September.

suggestions.topic: Sepolia shadow fork launch decision and client release status
suggestions.rationale: ACDT #94 targeted Sepolia for mid-to-end September pending devnet-9 stability and client releases. With Sept 3 today, need go/no-go decision and confirmation all clients have stable releases ready.

suggestions.topic: HiveChain RPC compatibility test blocker resolution
suggestions.rationale: ACDT #93 identified HiveChain PRs (#1589, #1585) blocking all RPC compat test writing for Glamsterdam. No resolution in ACDT #94. Critical for test coverage before public testnets.

suggestions.topic: REST SSZ Engine API (execution-apis PR #793) review status
suggestions.rationale: PR is spec-complete but stuck in Draft awaiting EL team reviews. Blocking merge into SSZ branch. Needs push to unblock before testnets.

suggestions.topic: FOCIL inclusion list P2P message size and empty transaction handling
suggestions.rationale: ACDT #94 proposed raising signed inclusion list size from 8KB to 41KB and rejecting empty transaction lists. No decisions reached; needs CL breakout discussion before testnet deployment.

suggestions.topic: Devnet-8 RPC interoperability issues and eth_estimateGas consistency
suggestions.rationale: Stefan's ACDT #93 report highlighted eth_estimateGas inconsistencies across clients on devnet-8. Client teams asked to review; no follow-up yet. Should be addressed before Sepolia.
